_how: Your Switch games, added by hand (Nintendo has no API). Copy _example into games, one entry per game. Find hours on the Switch: open your user page from the Home screen, then Play Activity. Save each cover image in assets/covers/ under the name you put in cover; the daily sync makes the small 200x300 copy. The sync never edits this file. The room shows the 36 most recent on the Switch shelf, newest lastPlayed first; the 4 beside the console are the most-completed (set completion 0-100 if you like).

_example.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
_example.note: Optional: a line shown when you click the game
